controles.affirmation: Recours collectif hopitaux: classe certifiee le 31/03/2025, proces fixe au 14/09/2027, perte non chiffrable
controles.verbatim_source: On March 31, 2025, the Court granted plaintiff's motion for class certification. The Court entered a scheduling order setting trial for September 14, 2027. Based on currently available information, the Company is unable to make a reasonable estimate of loss or range of losses, if any, arising from this matter. (10-Q T2 2026, Note 8)

controles.affirmation: Mars 2024: da Vinci et EndoWrist = marches distincts + pouvoir de monopole sur l'apres-vente, annules en juillet 2024
controles.verbatim_source: the Court ruled with plaintiffs that the da Vinci robot and EndoWrist instruments occupy separate product markets for antitrust purposes... Intuitive holds monopoly power in that aftermarket. / On July 30, 2024, the Court granted Intuitive's motion for reconsideration, vacating those portions of the Court's March 31, 2024, Order granting summary judgment as to the definition of a U.S. market for EndoWrist instrument repair and replacement and Intuitive's market power in such a market.

controles.affirmation: SIS gagnee en 1re instance janvier 2025, appel plaide le 25/06/2026 (9e circuit)
controles.verbatim_source: On January 28, 2025... the Court found in Intuitive's favor on all of SIS's antitrust claims... Oral argument took place on June 25, 2026.

controles.affirmation: Restore Robotics Repairs rejetee en novembre 2025 et en appel devant la cour du 11e circuit DEPUIS JUILLET 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On November 7, 2025, the Court entered an Order granting Intuitive's motion to dismiss. Plaintiff filed its notice of appeal to the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals on November 29, 2025... Restore's reply brief was filed on July 6, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: L'appel est pendant depuis le 29 novembre 2025, pas depuis juillet 2026. Le 6 juillet 2026 est la date de depot du memoire en replique de Restore. Ecrire: 'en appel devant la cour du 11e circuit depuis novembre 2025, memoire en replique depose le 6 juillet 2026'.

controles.affirmation: Instruments et accessoires 1 734,9 M$ sur 2 892,3 M$ soit 60,0 % du CA T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Instruments and accessories revenue $ 1,734.9 ... Total revenue $ 2,892.3 (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Marge brute T2 2026 retraitee des 35,9 M$ de remboursements IEEPA = 66,5 % contre 67,8 % publies
controles.verbatim_source: we recognized $27.5 million of refunds related to IEEPA tariffs paid in prior periods, which reduced cost of product revenues / $8.4 million... which reduced cost of service revenue. Calcul: (1 960,4 - 35,9)/2 892,3 = 66,5 %

controles.affirmation: Taux d'impot effectif S1 2026 de 17,3 % contre 8,8 %, avantages fiscaux excedentaires de 178,3 a 90,6 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Effective income tax rate 21.9% 20.2% 17.3 % 8.8% ... excess tax benefits associated with employee equity plans of $90.6 million and $178.3 million

controles.affirmation: Cadre national de prix NHSA publie au T2 2026, obligatoire pour toutes les provinces
controles.verbatim_source: China's National Healthcare Security Administration ("NHSA") issued guidelines establishing a unified national framework for robotic-assisted surgery pricing and requiring all provinces to implement robotic-assisted surgery pricing within NHSA-mandated limits in the upcoming quarters.
